queries.pubmed_query: depression AND cognitive behavioral therapy AND antidepressants

queries.pubmed_query: depression AND internet cognitive behavioral therapy

queries.pubmed_query: recurrent depression AND mindfulness based cognitive therapy AND relapse

queries.pubmed_query: adolescent depression AND cognitive behavioral therapy

queries.pubmed_query: generalized anxiety disorder AND cognitive behavioral therapy

queries.pubmed_query: generalized anxiety disorder AND selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors
queries.relevance_intent: Direct evidence concerns SSRIs and adult GAD symptom outcomes; other drug classes or mixed disorders alone are partial.

queries.pubmed_query: panic disorder AND exposure AND cognitive behavioral therapy
queries.relevance_intent: Direct evidence evaluates exposure-containing CBT and adult panic outcomes; nonspecific anxiety or CBT without an identifiable exposure component is partial.

queries.pubmed_query: social anxiety disorder AND cognitive behavioral therapy
queries.relevance_intent: Direct evidence concerns adult social anxiety disorder and CBT symptom outcomes; other age groups or mixed disorders without separate findings are partial.
